units: Sabb. VIII, 6 (81ᵃ) לִגְרוֹד Ar. a. ed. Y.; a. fr. [Editions a. Mss. mostly גָּרַר q. v.]—Part. pass. גָּרוּד stripped, v. גַּרְדּוּם.

senses.gloss: (denom. of גֶּרֶד 2) to cut the web with its fringes off the loom.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 72b:2">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>בגדי השרד</he> <cite ref="Exodus 35:19">Ex. XXXV, 19</cite>) <he>בגדים שגּוֹרְדִין אותן כברייתן מכליהן וכ׳</he> webs which they cut off the looms in their needed shape (so as to require no tailoring), leaving a small portion of the unwoven threads.
